categoryLabel: TOEIC 多益國際商務英語
subtopic: Part 5 詞性與詞尾變化
prompt: The board of directors expressed immense satisfaction with the ___ financial report submitted by the audit team.
explain: 空格位於定冠詞 the 與名詞詞組 financial report 之間，修飾名詞須填入形容詞 comprehensive（全面的、詳盡的）。
hint: 修飾名詞 report 需使用形容詞，觀察字尾 -ive 為標準形容詞字尾。

categoryLabel: TOEIC 多益國際商務英語
subtopic: Part 5 商務片語與固定搭配
prompt: All travel expense reimbursement claims must be submitted to the finance office ___ ten business days after returning from a business trip.
explain: 表示在特定天數或期限「之內」，介系詞使用 within；within ten business days 表在十個工作天內。
hint: 表示時間截止範圍的「在...之內」固定使用介系詞 within。

categoryLabel: TOEIC 多益國際商務英語
subtopic: Part 5 要求建議動詞與虛擬法
prompt: The chief executive officer requested that all department managers ___ present at the quarterly strategic planning conference.
explain: 表要求、建議、命令之動詞 (request, recommend, suggest, mandate) 後接 that 子句時，子句動詞省略 should，一律使用「原型動詞」be。
hint: CEO requested that S + (should) + 原型動詞，故選 be。

categoryLabel: TOEIC 多益國際商務英語
subtopic: Part 5 供應鏈與商務詞彙
prompt: Due to unexpected port congestion, the delivery of the electronic components will be delayed ___ further notice.
explain: until further notice 為極高頻多益商務慣用語塊，意指「在另行通知前」。
hint: 記誦標準商務語塊：until further notice（在另行通知之前）。

categoryLabel: TOEIC 多益國際商務英語
subtopic: Part 6 段落填空與轉折
prompt: The new inventory management software has reduced fulfillment errors by 35 percent. ___, it has significantly accelerated warehouse dispatch velocity.
explain: 前句說明軟體減少了 35% 出錯率，後句繼續陳述加速發貨速度的正面效益，前後為遞進補充關係，故選 Furthermore（此外）。
hint: 前後兩句皆為產品帶來的正面優勢，須選用表遞進追加的轉折副詞。

categoryLabel: TOEIC 多益國際商務英語
subtopic: Part 7 商務書信與採購詢價
passage:
Memo:
From: Logistics Director
To: Regional Vendors
Subject: Revised Purchase Order Policy
Effective October 1, all purchase orders exceeding $50,000 must obtain dual authorization from both the procurement manager and the regional finance director prior to vendor contract signing. Any unauthorized order will not be eligible for prompt payment discounts.
prompt: What is the main requirement of the new policy?
options: High-value orders require approval from two designated directors.
All vendors must submit shipments before October 1.
Payment discounts are permanently abolished for all orders.
Orders under $50,000 will be automatically cancelled.
explain: 備忘錄明確規定：超過五萬美元的採購單必須在簽約前取得採購經理與區域財務總監之雙重簽核 (dual authorization)。
hint: 檢索核心關鍵字：exceeding $50,000 must obtain dual authorization from both...

categoryLabel: TOEIC 多益國際商務英語
subtopic: Part 7 機票與行程確認
passage:
Itinerary Confirmation:
Passenger: Ms. Karen Clark
Flight: Pacific Air PA-882 (Nonstop)
Departure: Tokyo Narita (NRT) - 10:45 AM
Arrival: San Francisco (SFO) - 06:15 AM (Same Day)
Baggage Allowance: 2 checked pieces (max 23 kg each)
Boarding Gate closes strictly 20 minutes prior to scheduled departure time.
prompt: When must Ms. Clark arrive at the boarding gate at the latest?
explain: 班機預定 10:45 AM 出發，登機門於出發前 20 分鐘準時關閉 (20 minutes prior)，故最晚必須在 10:25 AM 到達。
hint: 計算：10:45 AM 減去 20 分鐘 = 10:25 AM。

categoryLabel: TOEIC 多益國際商務英語

prompt: Why is Mr. Scott being promoted?
options: He has demonstrated outstanding sales performance and market expansion.
He has worked at the enterprise for 28 years.
He is replacing an executive who was dismissed for misconduct.
He designed the company's financial accounting software.
explain: 公告明確肯定 Mr. Scott 在過去三年中使東南亞市場份額大幅成長 42% 的卓越市場開拓績效。
hint: 定位原因依據：Mr. Scott has successfully expanded our market share in Southeast Asia by 42%...

prompt: The chief executive officer requested that all department managers ___ present at the quarterly strategic planning conference.

categoryLabel: TOEIC 多益國際商務英語
subtopic: Part 5 供應鏈與商務詞彙
prompt: Due to unexpected port congestion, the delivery of the electronic components will be delayed ___ further notice.
explain: until further notice 為極高頻多益商務慣用語塊，意指「在另行通知前」。
hint: 記誦標準商務語塊：until further notice（在另行通知之前）。

categoryLabel: TOEIC 多益國際商務英語
subtopic: Part 6 段落填空與轉折
prompt: The new inventory management software has reduced fulfillment errors by 35 percent. ___, it has significantly accelerated warehouse dispatch velocity.
explain: 前句說明軟體減少了 35% 出錯率，後句繼續陳述加速發貨速度的正面效益，前後為遞進補充關係，故選 Furthermore（此外）。
hint: 前後兩句皆為產品帶來的正面優勢，須選用表遞進追加的轉折副詞。

categoryLabel: TOEIC 多益國際商務英語
subtopic: Part 7 商務書信與採購詢價
passage:
Memo:
From: Logistics Director
To: Regional Vendors
Subject: Revised Purchase Order Policy
Effective October 1, all purchase orders exceeding $50,000 must obtain dual authorization from both the procurement manager and the regional finance director prior to vendor contract signing. Any unauthorized order will not be eligible for prompt payment discounts.
prompt: What is the main requirement of the new policy?
options: High-value orders require approval from two designated directors.
All vendors must submit shipments before October 1.
Payment discounts are permanently abolished for all orders.
Orders under $50,000 will be automatically cancelled.
explain: 備忘錄明確規定：超過五萬美元的採購單必須在簽約前取得採購經理與區域財務總監之雙重簽核 (dual authorization)。
hint: 檢索核心關鍵字：exceeding $50,000 must obtain dual authorization from both...

subtopic: Part 7 機票與行程確認

prompt: The chief executive officer requested that all department managers ___ present at the quarterly strategic planning conference.

categoryLabel: TOEIC 多益國際商務英語
subtopic: Part 5 供應鏈與商務詞彙
prompt: Due to unexpected port congestion, the delivery of the electronic components will be delayed ___ further notice.
explain: until further notice 為極高頻多益商務慣用語塊，意指「在另行通知前」。
hint: 記誦標準商務語塊：until further notice（在另行通知之前）。

categoryLabel: TOEIC 多益國際商務英語
subtopic: Part 6 段落填空與轉折
prompt: The new inventory management software has reduced fulfillment errors by 35 percent. ___, it has significantly accelerated warehouse dispatch velocity.
explain: 前句說明軟體減少了 35% 出錯率，後句繼續陳述加速發貨速度的正面效益，前後為遞進補充關係，故選 Furthermore（此外）。
hint: 前後兩句皆為產品帶來的正面優勢，須選用表遞進追加的轉折副詞。

categoryLabel: TOEIC 多益國際商務英語
subtopic: Part 7 商務書信與採購詢價
passage:
Memo:
From: Logistics Director
To: Regional Vendors
Subject: Revised Purchase Order Policy
Effective October 1, all purchase orders exceeding $50,000 must obtain dual authorization from both the procurement manager and the regional finance director prior to vendor contract signing. Any unauthorized order will not be eligible for prompt payment discounts.
prompt: What is the main requirement of the new policy?
options: High-value orders require approval from two designated directors.
All vendors must submit shipments before October 1.
Payment discounts are permanently abolished for all orders.
Orders under $50,000 will be automatically cancelled.
explain: 備忘錄明確規定：超過五萬美元的採購單必須在簽約前取得採購經理與區域財務總監之雙重簽核 (dual authorization)。
hint: 檢索核心關鍵字：exceeding $50,000 must obtain dual authorization from both...

subtopic: Part 7 機票與行程確認

prompt: The chief executive officer requested that all department managers ___ present at the quarterly strategic planning conference.

categoryLabel: TOEIC 多益國際商務英語
subtopic: Part 5 供應鏈與商務詞彙
prompt: Due to unexpected port congestion, the delivery of the electronic components will be delayed ___ further notice.
explain: until further notice 為極高頻多益商務慣用語塊，意指「在另行通知前」。
hint: 記誦標準商務語塊：until further notice（在另行通知之前）。

categoryLabel: TOEIC 多益國際商務英語
subtopic: Part 6 段落填空與轉折
prompt: The new inventory management software has reduced fulfillment errors by 35 percent. ___, it has significantly accelerated warehouse dispatch velocity.
explain: 前句說明軟體減少了 35% 出錯率，後句繼續陳述加速發貨速度的正面效益，前後為遞進補充關係，故選 Furthermore（此外）。
hint: 前後兩句皆為產品帶來的正面優勢，須選用表遞進追加的轉折副詞。

categoryLabel: TOEIC 多益國際商務英語
subtopic: Part 7 商務書信與採購詢價
passage:
Memo:
From: Logistics Director
To: Regional Vendors
Subject: Revised Purchase Order Policy
Effective October 1, all purchase orders exceeding $50,000 must obtain dual authorization from both the procurement manager and the regional finance director prior to vendor contract signing. Any unauthorized order will not be eligible for prompt payment discounts.
prompt: What is the main requirement of the new policy?
options: High-value orders require approval from two designated directors.
All vendors must submit shipments before October 1.
Payment discounts are permanently abolished for all orders.
Orders under $50,000 will be automatically cancelled.
explain: 備忘錄明確規定：超過五萬美元的採購單必須在簽約前取得採購經理與區域財務總監之雙重簽核 (dual authorization)。
hint: 檢索核心關鍵字：exceeding $50,000 must obtain dual authorization from both...

subtopic: Part 7 機票與行程確認

categoryLabel: TOEIC 多益國際商務英語
subtopic: Part 6 段落填空與轉折
prompt: The new inventory management software has reduced fulfillment errors by 35 percent. ___, it has significantly accelerated warehouse dispatch velocity.

hint: 前後兩句皆為產品帶來的正面優勢，須選用表遞進追加的轉折副詞。
